answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the falcon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the voyage of the next round. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
